related_questions.question: How to find out who owns a property in GA?

text_blocks.snippet: To find out who owns a property in Georgia, you can typically search public records at the county level, often through the Clerk of Superior Court's office or the Tax Assessor's website. The Georgia Superior Court Clerks' Cooperative Authority (GSCCCA) also provides a centralized resource for searching property records.
snippet_highlighted_words: search public records at the county level, often through the Clerk of Superior Court's office or the Tax Assessor's website

text_blocks.snippet: 1. Identify the County: Determine which county the property is located in.

list.title: Clerk of Superior Court:
list.snippet: Visit the county's Clerk of Superior Court's office or website. They maintain property records, including deeds, mortgages, and other ownership documents.

list.title: Tax Assessor's Office:
list.snippet: Many counties have their tax assessor's office websites where you can search for property information, including ownership details.

list.title: GSCCCA Website:
list.snippet: The GSCCCA website offers a centralized platform to search for property records across all Georgia counties.

list.title: County Websites:
list.snippet: Many counties provide online portals for searching property records. Check the specific county's website for these resources.
Address: Search by the property's address.
Parcel ID: Search by the property's unique parcel identification number.
Owner Name: Search by the name of the current or previous owner.

text_blocks.snippet: 5. Review Documents: Carefully review the property records, such as deeds, to identify the current owner and any past ownership history.

related_questions.question: What is the role of a tax assessor?
related_questions.snippet: A tax assessor is a local government official who works with appraisers to determine the property value in a specific city or town. The value of the property gets converted into an assessment used to calculate property tax bills. Assessments may need to be changed periodically based on fluctuating property values.
